result.rationale: The trajectory shows a clear pattern of repeated contested failures (target_zone_capacity_lost) across turns 1-5, with 16 hard failures and 15 capacity failures total. The rescue team (engineer-imani, medic-reyes, security-chen) remains stuck in command-deck for all 6 turns, repeatedly issuing guard::command-deck intents that all resolve as no_effect (no_hostile_movement_triggered), while hostile/pirate actors repeatedly fail on target_zone_capacity_lost. The team never moves toward Hive Alpha or any objective, and the only attack action (turn 3 pirate-captain-veyra scatter-blast) is invalidated as target_out_of_range_after_movement. The repeated capacity contestation and no-effect guard actions add little new information each turn, and the team makes zero objective progress across all 6 turns. This is the dominant, bounded causal pattern.
